Kalaha: Flytt kuler rundt brettet og sam: Mancala: move stones round the board and gather the most in your store – the big hollow at your end.
Ta alle kulene i et av dine seks hull. L: Take all the stones from one of your six pits. Drop one in each pit after it, anticlockwise – into your own store too, but never your opponent's.
Havner den siste kula i kalahaen din, få: If the last stone lands in your store, you get another turn. If it lands in an empty pit on your side, you take it and all the stones in the pit opposite.
Når den ene siden er tom, tar hver av de: When one side is empty, each of you takes the stones left on your own side. The most stones in the store wins.
Tell kulene: Har et hull like mange kule: Count the stones: if a pit holds as many stones as there are steps to your store, you get another turn.
Pass på hullene dine som står tomme – og: Watch your empty pits – and your opponent's pits opposite them.
Velg 6 kuler i hvert hull for et lengre: Pick 6 stones per pit for a longer, less predictable game.
